text: The subject is Mehwish Zafar, who holds account PK**HABB****1661 opened on 26 October 2025. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 April 2026 and 11 April 2026, the account recorded 28 credits totalling PKR 1,450,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 1,306,000. The credits consisted of 28 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 23 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 11 April 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 23 distinct senders is indicative of money mule activity. Debits equal to 90% of credits, with a median of 2.7 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with suspected money mule activity. Credits in the activity window were 58.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student, which is indicative of money mule activity. The pattern of 23 distinct senders and credits 58.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month for a Student is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 849,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 457,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 3 transactions. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 29 April 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review by L2 analyst on 12 April 2026.
